findings.claim: The instruction to fix the parser says 'vazio/ausente nas fases default e na restauracao deve passar'. That wording allows a DETRAN_LOCAL_ACTOR_ID that is present but empty, which contradicts the current assert in tools/stack/contract.test.mjs:576-580 (actorState 'absent', message 'including empty') and the fix in delivery-review-CTG-0002.json finding 3 ('delete the key, do not pass an empty string'). The real bug is only the trim() at contract.test.mjs:555. It removes the final empty field of the last restart line, so actorValue becomes undefined instead of ''. The actor was already correctly absent (TASK-0007-delivery-fix.md:37). With the current wording, the Inspector can relax actorState to accept 'present' with an empty value, which weakens the default-actor rule.
findings.fix: Rewrite lines 50-53: 'Replace .trim().split with a split that keeps trailing fields (for example split(/\n/) plus filter(Boolean), with no trim on the line). actorState must stay exactly absent in the seven non-MEDICO phases and in the restore. A present variable, even an empty one, fails. Only MEDICO has actorState present with ...b0000002.'

findings.claim: The prompt asks the test for the 'comando literal SEFAZ' (contract.test.mjs:594) to prove that invalid_body came from the adapter (SefazAdapterError/BUSINESS_ERROR/400/retryable=false). The literal command is a child process whose only observable output is the stdout markers. sefaz-adapter-smoke.mjs:130-148 emits 'invalid_body' after an adapter check and also after a raw fetch, and the Inspector cannot change that script. On the literal command the sensor is impossible without touching production. The feasible place is the tsx child script at contract.test.mjs:129-219. It already uses the real adapter on an ephemeral port, but today it tests invalid body only with raw fetch (lines 205-213) and 405 without the full envelope (lines 214-218). The prompt does not point there.
findings.fix: State that proof of the adapter-origin error, the full 400/404/405 envelope, the generated requestId and the IPv4 check go in the tsx child sensor (contract.test.mjs:129), through adapter.lookupDebt({}) with an instanceof/name SefazAdapterError check. The literal-command sensor keeps its markers and exit code, with no change to sefaz-adapter-smoke.mjs.

findings.claim: Section 4 asks for separate scratch databases, reapplication, FK and legacy-ID checks in rait-seed-profiles.integration.spec.ts. That spec needs a real Postgres (DETRAN_SEED_ADMIN_DATABASE_URL/DETRAN_SEED_SCRATCH_DATABASE_URL, spec lines 91-111). Line 6 forbids any real database, and lines 62-66 list only offline commands, so the new C-02-01 sensors would be written without ever running. The spec also uses a fixed scratch name (line 10). A second scratch for fresh-local-stack/legacy-upgrade needs its own name and its own create-if-absent/drop guard, which the prompt does not require.
findings.fix: Either authorize explicitly running `vitest run` on the spec against the ephemeral local Postgres, with a scratch per profile under distinct names, refusing to reuse and dropping in afterAll, or state that the spec is delivered unexecuted and C-02-01 stays not green. Require that no scratch name matches detran_local_stack or the shared database.

findings.claim: The task still shows status 'completed', iteration_count 1 and prompt_composition_id PC-43f78fb54ba03f4a from iteration 1. The prompt (line 72) tells the worker to report the PC from this JSON. Iteration 2 would then be recorded under the PC of the previous composition.
findings.fix: Before dispatch, update status/iteration_count to 2 and register the PC for TASK-0011-delivery-coverage.md, then reference it in the report.

findings.claim: The prompt correctly asks to replace the unbounded wait in the node stub ('while [[ ! -f .../sefaz-mock.pid ]]; do :; done'), which busy-waits and can hang the suite. The prompt does not set a numeric bound and does not say the diagnostic must show up as a test failure rather than a stub exit.
findings.fix: Set a bound (for example 50 x 0.1s using the real sleep, or a counter) and require a stderr message naming sefaz-mock.pid.
